prompt: As of August 2, 2024, what is the title of the most viewed episode in the second most viewed season of the TV show that Zooey Deschanel stars in as a character named "Jess Day"?
answer: The second most viewed season was **Season 2** of *New Girl* (average of 5.85 million U.S. viewers). Its most viewed episode was **“Re-Launch,”** which attracted approximately **5.35 million viewers**.
